disposition_reason: The paper provides ordered behavioral and neural prediction results for both complete widefield assays and thirteen fUS sessions, including numerical Table 2–3 SBIND baselines. Exact data identities, published folds/preprocessing replay, full evaluator and a justified joint decision rule remain incomplete; no execution readiness or improvement is claimed.

source_paper.title: Dynamical Modeling of Behaviorally Relevant Spatiotemporal Patterns in Neural Imaging Data

evidence.locator: Sections 3.4, 4.1.1, 4.3–4.4; Tables 2–3; Appendices A.1.6 and A.4
evidence.supports: Original predictions, data dimensions, modality-specific metrics and numeric author results.
Current pinned code uses contiguous frame blocks and per-training-input normalization; MSE returns per-output values and F1 is handled by classification branch.
Tutorial uses random placeholder arrays and is not a complete original-data reproduction route.

target.description: Joint prediction of neural images and behavior from neural image history: WFCI1 continuous behavior, WFCI2 binary contact traces, and fUS trial target direction. Neural/continuous predictions are one-step-ahead; fUS direction is decoded from the final trial latent state.

dataset.description: Two Churchland/Musall widefield assays and the Griggs fUS dataset identified by the paper. Exact deposit-to-assay/session identities are not yet bound to executable manifests.

cohort.description: WFCI1 has 248 trials/49,008 frames and 14 behavior channels; WFCI2 has 412 trials/38,927 frames and four binary traces. fUS has thirteen nonhuman-primate sessions: nine two-directional and four eight-directional, using successful trials.

split.description: Paper specifies five folds for each widefield dataset and ten per fUS session. Pinned DataSplitter partitions contiguous frame indices, not authenticated whole trials. Exact paper fold membership and whether trial boundaries were crossed remain unverified; the local whole-trial constructor cannot silently replace them.

inputs.description: Full 1×128×128 neural image fields with aligned behavior available for training; inference uses neural images only. fUS behavior supervision is restricted to three target-fixation samples in each 30-frame trial.

preprocessing.description: Appendix A.4: widefield hemodynamic regression, brain crop/downsampling and causal 0.1-Hz second-order high-pass filtering; 14 video PCs or four sensor traces. fUS uses causal 0.02-Hz filtering, rolling 60-frame voxel z-scoring, radius-2 pillbox smoothing and crop to 128×128. Original executable transform/mask identities remain to authenticate.

metric.description: MSE is mean squared prediction error (lower); WFCI2 behavior uses F1 (higher); fUS accuracy is correctly decoded trials divided by evaluated trials (higher). Full source vector must be retained; one chosen favorable endpoint cannot establish the joint claim.

aggregation.description: Tables 2–3 report mean±SEM over five widefield folds or ten folds and sessions by fUS direction task. Source supplements describe behavior-channel and brain-pixel averages; exact masks, weighting order and F1 class/channel conventions must be bound to the original table execution. Folds are not independent animals.

comparison.primary_metric: WFCI1 behavioral MSE is a numeric anchor only; full Table 2–3 joint vector required

published_baseline.description: Table 2 SBIND WFCI1 behavioral MSE=0.4955±0.0254 SEM; neural MSE=0.0414±0.0029. WFCI2 F1=0.4569±0.0036 and neural MSE=0.1644±0.0090. Table 3 two-direction fUS accuracy=0.7300±0.0191 and neural MSE=0.4725±0.0165; eight-direction accuracy=0.3521±0.0201 and neural MSE=0.3919±0.0107. The scalar value records only the first anchor, not an authorization to narrow the complete task.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Pinned author model implementation exists, but its random-array tutorial and local preparation helpers do not establish original-table replay.

minimum_effect.rationale: A task-specific practically meaningful effect has not been justified; source reproduction tolerances and reported SEM are not improvement margins.

uncertainty.independent_unit: Sessions/animals for biological claims; whole trials for conditional within-session error, with temporal dependence preserved.
uncertainty.rationale: Published SEM across overlapping folds is not an independent-replication confidence interval for improvement. Authenticate session/animal identities and define a paired dependent-data procedure for the full metric vector before evaluation.

paper_win_requires: Reproduce all Table 2–3 SBIND cells on the original complete assays and thirteen fUS sessions before admitting a candidate comparison.
Recover original folds, preprocessing, trial masks, class metrics and aggregation; changed whole-trial/held-session/held-animal splits are extensions.
Predeclare a joint behavioral/neural rule with task-specific meaningful changes and uncertainty across the full vector; improving WFCI1 MSE alone does not establish this registered full-scope win.
Preserve original neural-history input and fUS supervised-sample restrictions with matched comparator budgets.
Separate published table scores, fresh author reruns and any independently sourced later SOTA scores.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was performed; source-paper reproduction and source-author reruns are separate claims.

episode.improvement_loop: After source admission, iterate using the recovered original training/validation interface for both widefield assays and all fUS conditions; do not optimize on final table outcomes.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze code, selected architecture/hyperparameters, complete assay/session roster, transforms, folds, joint success rule and resource accounting before final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: One admitted final evaluation emits every Table 2–3 metric with paired author-baseline predictions and all scope/mask receipts; preserve original input and split conditions.
episode.baseline_policy: Use the source SBIND procedure as the paper comparator; DPAD/CEBRA/TNDM and ablations remain controls. A newly corrected split has a separately rerun author baseline and is labelled an extension.

blocking_issues: Exact two widefield acquisition identities and all thirteen fUS session mappings are not authenticated.
Paper fold manifests are unrecovered; current author frame splitter differs from the local whole-trial preparation design.
Complete real-data preprocessing, metric aggregation/masks and original model-selection procedure lack replay parity.
No task-specific full-vector improvement/noninferiority rule, valid uncertainty or concrete attempt/access budgets is frozen.
No complete working model evaluator or author-baseline rerun exists in the reviewed local preparation-only implementations.

legacy.notes: Whole-trial-preparation and continuous-normalization implementations prepare arrays and assert schemas; they are calibration/construction components. Their corrected trial boundaries must not be relabelled the published protocol.
